support_sent: Your message was sent to support.
support_failed: Your message could not be delivered to support right now. Please try again.
support_reply_failed: The reply could not be delivered to the user.
rate_limited: Please wait and try again shortly.
unsupported: This input type is not supported yet.
provider_failed: The execution provider was unavailable. Credit is released if the task fails permanently.
provider_invalid: A reliable result could not be produced. Reserved credit was released.
file_expired: The file expired or is unavailable. Upload it again.
image_unclear: The image is empty or unreadable. Send a clearer image; this task will not charge credit.
ocr_unclear: The image could not be read clearly, so this request did not complete. Start a new request with a clearer image.
ocr_description: Extract original image text; optional separate translation after delivery
enhancement_not_improved: No reliable improvement preserving the image details was found, so this order could not be completed. Try a clearer original image.
ocr_images: Send up to 5 clear images, then tap Done. For small text, send the image as a file to retain detail.
result_complete: Your result has been delivered. You can request another service or return home.
result_followups: Original text extraction is complete. Translation is optional in a separate order; the price appears before confirmation.
followup_unavailable: This option is unavailable now. The result may have expired, translation may be disabled, or the text may exceed its limits.
followup_draft_exists: You have a draft in progress. Finish or cancel it first, then select Translate text.
office_text: Send the content and name the document type if important: report, letter, or memo. Your Word choice applies to the entire text. For Excel, put each record on a separate line: up to 200 nonempty lines and 4,000 characters per line within the text limit. Data is organized with source references; ambiguous dates and identifiers remain text.
office_word_mode: How should Word handle your content? Preserve the text as written, or improve wording and organization while preserving facts. Both options have the same service price.
office_word_smart: Improve wording and organization with AI
document_mode: Choose the content outcome: preserve the text without rewriting, or organize the content. Both options have the same service price.
document_title: The title is optional. Enter a short title on one line, such as Sales report, or choose No title. Do not send the full text here. Maximum 200 characters.
input_single_line: Enter this field on one line only.
document_direct_no_title_preview: Converted your text directly without AI, rewriting, or an added title.
document_direct_preview:
Text converted directly without AI or rewriting.

pdf_text: Send the text to convert to PDF. Next choose whether to preserve the text or organize its content.
more_files: File received. Send another or tap Done.
excel_data_notes: Review: {missing} blank cells and {repeated} repeated rows retained from the source.
excel_usage: Values are editable. Use the table header arrows to sort and filter, and add records below the table. No automatic calculations or totals were added.

needs_information: Essential information is missing. Reserved credit was released. Submit a new request with more details.

pdf_text_unreadable: This PDF includes scanned or non-extractable content. Send a fully text-based copy to avoid losing content.
pdf_text_too_long: The PDF text exceeds this service's safe limit. Split the file and try again.

help_text:
How to complete a task

1. Choose a service.
2. Send your content and follow the prompts.
3. Review the cost and confirm execution.
4. Receive the result here and track progress in My orders.

Credit is reserved only after confirmation. Navigation preserves your draft; selecting a service starts a new draft.

/menu Home
/services Services
/orders My orders
/wallet Credit
/resume Resume draft
/cancel Cancel draft or leave support
/lang Language
/support Contact support

Credit is for testing only. Temporary files are deleted automatically; save your result when it arrives.
orders_title:
📋 My orders — page {page}
Select an order to view its status and details.
no_orders: No orders on this page. Start a task from Services.
order_unavailable: This order is not available in your account.
structure_approved: Structure approved. We will continue processing and send the result here.
unknown_input: Choose a service to get started or open Help for the steps.
pdf_tools_description: Merge PDFs or extract selected pages without rewriting page content.
pdf_tools_files: Send PDFs in the required order, then tap Done. Merge: two to five files; extraction: one file. Total limit: 200 pages and 20 MB. Fillable forms and signed PDFs are unsupported.
pdf_tools_pages: Enter page numbers in the required order, such as 1-3,5 or 3,1. No duplicates; maximum 200 pages.
pdf_tools_limit: PDF tool limits exceeded: 200 total pages, 20 MB total and 10 MB per file.
pdf_tools_form: This PDF contains a fillable form or signature; this tool does not support editing it.
pdf_page_selection: Invalid page selection or a page exceeds the document. Use a selection such as 1-3,5 without duplicates.
pdf_tools_preview: PDF ready. Pages were copied in the requested order. Document outlines and metadata are not transferred.
local_ocr_description: Read printed text from images without translation. Review text and numbers before use.
local_ocr_images: Send up to five clear printed-text images in order, then tap Done. Limits: 10 MB each, 20 MB total. Images are resized to 1024 pixels; avoid dense pages and handwriting.
local_ocr_language: Choose the language in the images; the text will not be translated.
local_ocr_busy: The document processor is busy; this request will be retried automatically.
local_ocr_timeout: Reading the image exceeded the time limit; this request did not complete.
local_ocr_unavailable: The local text processor is unavailable or could not process the image; this request did not complete.
local_ocr_preview: Automatically recognized text without translation. Errors can occur even at high confidence; check text and numbers against the original images.
document_output_format: Choose the files to receive. This service has the same price for all formats.
word_pdf_name: Create a Word or PDF document
word_pdf_description: Choose Word, PDF or both; preserve the text or improve wording and document design with AI.
word_pdf_text: Send the text once. Preserve mode: up to 12,000 characters. Improvement: up to 9,000 characters and 80 nonempty lines, up to 4,000 characters per line. Do not embed instructions; text is treated as document content.
word_pdf_title: Send an optional document title (one line, up to 200 characters), or tap Skip.
word_pdf_preview: The document is ready. Text was preserved without rewriting. Review pages before use.
document_render_busy: The document processor is busy; this request will be retried automatically.
document_render_unavailable: The document converter is unavailable or could not process the document; this request did not complete.
document_render_timeout: PDF creation exceeded the time limit; this request did not complete.
document_render_limit: Document conversion limits exceeded: 50 pages or 10 MB.
document_render_invalid: A valid PDF could not be created; this request did not complete.
cv_description: Enter your actual details once. AI edits the wording, translates into your requested language and selects a professional design. Receive editable Word and matching PDF; bilingual output contains a complete Arabic CV then English in the same document. No invented qualifications or experience; review before applying.
cv_language: Choose the final CV language: Arabic, English, or both in one document. Enter your details once in Arabic or English; we edit and translate automatically. The document may span multiple pages.
cv_full_name: Enter the name to display at the top, on one line.
cv_contact: Enter contact details to display: phone, email, city or professional link. Do not include a national ID or full home address.
cv_summary: Enter a profile if available, or skip so AI drafts a short profile grounded in your actual education, skills and experience.
cv_experience: Enter actual experience: title, organization, dates, responsibilities or achievements. List roles newest first. If you have no experience, skip; education is required in the next step.
cv_education: Enter your actual qualification or education stage and institution, optionally graduation year or current study status. This field is required and cannot be skipped; students and graduates do not need work experience.
cv_skills: Enter your actual skills once in Arabic or English. We improve the wording without adding skills you did not provide.
cv_additional: Enter certifications, languages or portfolio links, or skip.
cv_preview: AI reviewed and edited the wording, translated it and selected the design. Check names, qualifications, experience, dates and contacts. Editable Word and matching PDF.
images_pdf_description: Combine up to five images in supplied order into a PDF, one image per page with no cropping or aspect distortion. Clarity depends on received images; no OCR or resolution enhancement.
images_pdf_images: Send up to five images in the desired PDF page order. Send them as files to preserve resolution; Telegram may reduce quality when they are sent as ordinary photos.
images_pdf_orientation: Choose A4 page orientation. Automatic mode matches each page to its image.
images_pdf_preview: PDF with {pages} images in supplied order, without cropping or aspect distortion. Check clarity before printing or sharing.
minutes_description: Organize supplied notes into discussion, decisions, actions and review, with an assignee/deadline register and source references. Approve organization before Word/PDF export; never invent names or dates.
minutes_title: Enter the final meeting title on one line.
minutes_language: Choose the minute heading language. Notes remain in their original language; translation is not included.
minutes_notes: Send connected text or separate lines. Sentences are separated automatically: up to 12000 characters, 80 notes and 1200 characters per note. Include known owners/deadlines; review organization before export.
minutes_review_intro: Proposed organization with counts and samples. IDs refer to source notes after automatic sentence separation. Review categories, owners and deadlines before approving Word/PDF; unknown values remain Not specified.
minutes_review_complete: Complete minutes review before Word/PDF creation. Every source note is shown with its category, and every task with its owner and deadline. Quotes are not shortened; Not specified means the source did not identify the value. The review may span several messages; approval buttons appear in the last message.
minutes_review_complete_end: Complete review finished. Approve if categories, owners and deadlines are correct. If something is wrong, cancel this order and send corrected notes.
minutes_preview: Word and PDF minutes using approved organization and an action register. References trace paragraphs and table entries to source; verify decisions, owners and deadlines before sharing.
minutes_input_invalid: Send a single-line title up to 200 characters and notes up to 12000 characters, 80 notes and 1200 characters per note after sentence separation. Use Arabic/English without invalid control characters.
csv_review_description: Pasted CSV to sortable Excel with original values, blank/duplicate review and optional lexical similarity report. No deletion, merging or inferred types.
csv_review_language: Choose review heading language (your data is not translated):
csv_review_delimiter: Choose the delimiter used in the CSV:
csv_review_whitespace: How should spaces and tabs at the edges of cell values be handled?
csv_review_trim: Trim edge spaces and tabs only
csv_review_text: Paste CSV with column names in the first record. Up to 12,000 characters and 20 columns. Limit: 500 records for usual review, or 200 with the similarity report. Do not upload a file. All values are preserved as text, including IDs and numbers.
csv_review_preview: Organized {rows} records. Blank cells: {blanks}; duplicate records after the selected rule: {duplicates}; edge-trimmed cells: {changes}. No records deleted.
csv_review_summary:
Records: {rows} | Blank cells: {blanks} | Duplicates: {duplicates} | Trimmed cells: {changes}
Column numbers start at 1. Record number is in the added last column of Data/Source. A blank duplicate field means no duplicate.
csv_review_rules: Rule: {mode}. Column headings have no edge spaces. All values are text; no numeric/date conversion or totals. Empty fields stay blank; all records retained. Review describes values at creation and does not update after workbook edits.
csv_similarity_prompt: Add a report of lexically similar records? This option supports up to 200 records. It does not decide duplicates or delete/merge anything.
csv_similarity_preview: Lexically similar pairs: {similar_pairs}. Shown in Similarities: {shown_pairs}; not shown: {omitted_pairs}. Review candidates only, not proof of duplicates. No records deleted or merged.
csv_similarity_summary:
Candidate pairs: {similar_pairs} | Shown: {shown_pairs} | Not shown: {omitted_pairs}
Record numbers are the references added to Data/Source; columns start at 1. Score is the minimum lexical similarity of different cells, not a duplicate probability. Every different cell must reach 90.
Only the selected whitespace rule applies; no letter normalization or translation. Different empty/numeric-bearing cells are excluded; true duplicates may be missed. Exact equality is in Review.
First 1000 pairs ordered by second then first record; no deletion or merging. Static report, not updated after edits. Zero pairs means no candidates; an empty report row is not a data record.

text_translation_description: Translate to Arabic or English in your selected style, with numeric and source-line checks. Text and TXT file; not certified translation.
text_translation_input: Send text to translate: up to 12000 characters and 80 nonempty lines.
text_translation_language: Which language should the text be translated into?
text_editing_description: Proofread or rewrite in the original language with numeric/contact checks. Edited text, UTF-8 TXT and a line-by-line changes report for your review.
text_editing_input: Send Arabic or English text: up to 12000 characters and 80 nonempty lines. Review the draft against the original before use.
text_editing_tone: Choose a rewriting tone. Proofreading only keeps the original tone.
text_summary_description: Concise decisions, actions and deadlines with meaning/number review and a TXT report containing source references.
text_summary_input: Send text up to 12000 characters and 80 nonempty lines. A single paragraph is accepted; manual line splitting is unnecessary.
text_summary_invalid: Send nonempty text up to 12000 characters and 80 lines, without invalid control characters. A single paragraph is accepted.
text_summary_length: Choose summary length. Short sources may need fewer points.
text_summary_language: Choose the summary language. The original source remains in the attached report.
text_summary_notice: Source and references are in the attached file. Review important details before relying on the summary.
pdf_tables_description: Extract text PDF tables to Excel with source values and page references; generic, first-row or proposed headings.
pdf_tables_file: Send an unencrypted text-only PDF without images: up to 5 pages and 10 MiB, with a table on each page. Extracted tables need review; PDF layout is not reconstructed.
pdf_tables_method: Choose the table layout in the source.
pdf_tables_mode: Choose generic, first-row or proposed headings. First-row mode promotes the first row of every table into Data headings and keeps it in Source. Headers must be unique and nonblank, without edge whitespace or line breaks, and at most 100 characters each; otherwise use generic columns.
pdf_tables_language: Choose the review and generic/proposed heading language. Source headings and extracted values are not translated.
pdf_tables_arabic_order: Does extracted Arabic appear reversed? Recovery is only for Arabic stored in visual order using presentation forms, not ordinary Arabic. Cells mixed with numbers, English or symbols stay unchanged; compare with the source.
pdf_tables_arabic_review: You selected visual-order Arabic recovery in Data for simple Arabic cells only. Source preserves extracted text; mixed cells remain unchanged. Compare the result with the PDF.
pdf_tables_arabic_note: Selected visual-order Arabic recovery: {changed} cells changed; {skipped} cells with presentation forms left unchanged. Source preserves extraction. This choice does not certify content; compare with the PDF.
pdf_tables_source_note: Extracted from page {page}. Generic columns; every row including the original header is retained. This is not a verified PDF transcription; compare with the original.
pdf_tables_sheet_note: PDF page {page} — {mode}. All values are text; leading zeros retained. Extracted source is in Source; proposed headings need review.
pdf_tables_audit_note: Metrics come from the extractor, not proof of cell accuracy or table completeness. Compare all data against the original PDF; Source retains extracted values only. Data headings may be AI proposals.
pdf_tables_review: Review table structure before creating Excel. All extracted values are retained; compare the output with the original PDF.
pdf_tables_delivered:
Excel ready for review.

Workbook contents:
• Tables: Data
• Extracted values: Source
• References and metrics: Review

Compare cells against the original PDF.
pdf_tables_limit: File/table limits: 5 pages/tables, 200 rows and 12 columns per table, 5000 cells and 50000 characters total.
pdf_tables_missing: No supported text table found on every page. Try a PDF containing only table pages and the appropriate extraction method.
pdf_tables_quality: Could not extract tables within quality limits. Try the other method or a clearer PDF; no guessed data was delivered.
pdf_tables_unavailable: The table extraction engine is unavailable.
pdf_tables_busy: The document engine is busy; the job will retry.
pdf_tables_timeout: Table extraction exceeded its time limit.
document_preview_caption: First-page preview of the PDF prepared for delivery.
document_preview_invalid: Could not prepare the document preview. Please try again.
document_preview_timeout: Document preview took too long. Please try again.
catalog_choose: Choose a category, then the service you need:
catalog_documents_description: Create Word, Excel or PDF from text, or create PowerPoint slides. Content and formatting options follow service selection.
catalog_text_description: Translate, proofread or rewrite text, and create concise summaries.
catalog_images_description: Extract text from images or improve document-image clarity. Translating extracted text is a separate optional service.
catalog_pdf_description: Convert PDF to Word, combine images into PDF, merge PDFs or extract selected pages.
catalog_data_description: Convert PDF tables to Excel, organize CSV and review data.
catalog_professional_description: Format supplied CV details or meeting notes into Word and PDF.
catalog_empty: No services are available in this category now. Choose another category.
document_image_description: Improve document-image clarity with AI-supported processing selection and quality review; original and comparison included.
document_image_input: Send the document image, preferably as a file to retain quality. We automatically enhance it and include the source for comparison.
document_image_mode: Choose processing. Grayscale removes colors; check text, numbers and stamps after processing.
document_image_result:
Images prepared:
• enhanced: enhanced image
• comparison: source left, enhanced right
• received: unchanged image received by the bot

Check text, numbers and stamps against the source. Processing does not restore lost detail or guarantee removal of screen-photo moire. Enhancement resolution is up to 2048 pixels on the longest side.

profile_update_failed: Bot information update was not completed. Some descriptions may have changed; retry /syncprofile.
admin_private_service: Internal admin-only tool; not listed for customers. Normal activation and payment settings still apply.
admin_readiness_intro: Choose a service to inspect status and settings, then manage activation or price from its details. Opening details changes nothing and does not test result quality.
admin_listed: Listing: included in the customer menu by the current activation and payment-price filters.
admin_not_listed: Listing: excluded from the customer menu by the current activation and payment-price filters.
admin_version_mismatch: Warning: stored version {stored} differs from code {source}. Check component updates and registry synchronization.
admin_ai_paused: AI configuration: paused by operational control.
admin_ai_invalid: AI configuration: invalid for local call-cost calculation. Check provider configuration and rates.
admin_ai_configured: AI configuration: local cost calculation is configured; connection, balance and model quality have not been tested.
admin_ai_required: This service requires AI configuration. Disabling or pausing it blocks requests that need it.
admin_ai_input_dependent: AI is not mandatory for every request; some options or paths may need it depending on inputs.
admin_ai_none: This service runs without AI; pausing AI does not block its direct execution.
admin_stars_mode: Current payment mode: Telegram Stars per order.
admin_test_credit_mode: Current payment mode: test credit; Stars is disabled.
admin_missing_stars_price: Set a Stars price to list this service in the current payment mode.
admin_readiness_limits: Configuration evidence only, not operational approval. Worker containers, native tools, files, remaining spending budgets and actual customer acceptance are not checked. Test the service after updating before making it available.
admin_activation_enable_warning: Enabling admits new orders under current prices/settings and resets the previous circuit pause. It does not activate payment, change prices or certify output quality or worker tools. Test before serving customers.
admin_activation_disable_warning: Disabling blocks new orders and queues cancellation of the specified unfinished orders. Test-credit reservations are released; recorded payments enter Stars refund workflow, not a completed refund until Telegram confirms it. Completed orders are not cancelled. An in-flight provider call may continue and its cost is not erased by disabling.
admin_activation_enabled: Service enabled and change recorded. Prices retained; actual environment output acceptance is still required.
admin_activation_disabled: Service disabled and change recorded. A durable task cancels the specified orders, if any; the worker resumes it. Stars refunds remain pending until Telegram confirms them. Prices retained.
admin_activation_changed: Service state/settings or affected orders changed. Reopen the service and review again.
admin_activation_pending: Cancellation from a previous disable is unfinished. Check the worker and activation history before enabling again.
admin_activation_limit: Affected orders or payments exceed the panel's safe review bound. No change; operational handling is required before retrying.
admin_activation_recorded: Change recorded; follow Stars refunds in the Stars report
cv_type: Choose the purpose of your CV. AI improves wording, section order and design without inventing facts. Skip = general professional.
cv_headline: Enter your actual professional title or specialty on one line, or skip. Enter it once in your preferred language.
cv_projects: Enter actual projects, training or volunteering: name, your role and details, or skip.
cv_languages: Enter languages and your actual proficiency, or skip.
cv_research: Enter actual research interests and experience, or skip.
cv_publications: Enter actual publications and their details exactly as you want them displayed, or skip.
word_pdf_mode: How should the document be prepared? Preserve text uses no AI. Improvement edits wording, organizes paragraphs and selects a design without translation or new facts. Skip preserves text.
word_pdf_smart: Improve content and design with AI
word_pdf_smart_preview: The document is prepared with improved wording, organization and design. Review meaning, names, data and page layout before use; this is not independent fact verification.
excel_source_review: Each row has a source reference; all original nonempty source lines is in Source. Context lines outside data rows: {context}. Review context classification and column association; these checks do not certify meaning.
catalog_ai_notice: Some services or improvement options are temporarily unavailable. Direct paths that do not need AI remain available.
service_ai_unavailable: This service is temporarily unavailable. No order was created or credit reserved. Choose a direct conversion service or try again later. Any existing draft is preserved.
pdf_tables_source_headers_review: You selected the first row of every table as headings, without translation or suggestions. Review every heading below: the first row will not repeat in Data records and stays intact in Source with its R1 reference. This choice does not prove that the first row really is a header.
pdf_tables_source_headers_note: Data headings come from extracted row R1; records start at R2. Source keeps the first row, and original row references are not renumbered.
editing_changes_summary: Changed lines: {changed} of {total} original lines, including blank lines.
editing_changes_scope: The changes section shows only literal differences, followed by the complete original for context. Line numbers count blanks. Line endings are normalized; this is not an assessment of meaning or style.
editing_changes_none: No literal differences after line-ending normalization.
